g.text: Code baseline 3efa44c; formulas C01-C38 / L01-L17 / Z01-Z03 / R01-R04
No call from formal chasi_run to cf_search; optional legacy adapter is a separate branch.
Old search budget counts candidate evaluations. Optional chasiNative changes ObjectiveName to estimated PF; it does not turn the formal scene into an outer search loop.
